title: Rubric: Sikku Kolam 5x5 Pulli Dot Matrix Trajectory

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Step 1: Establish a 5x5 staggered matrix of dots (pulli) with equal 40mm Euclidean spacing on a clean horizontal surface. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: Establish a 5x5 staggered matrix of dots (pulli) with equal 40mm Euclidean spacing on a clean horizontal surface.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Step 2: The line must weave around each pulli dot without touching, intersecting, or lifting the drawing medium, completing a single continuous closed topological path. [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: The line must weave around each pulli dot without touching, intersecting, or lifting the drawing medium, completing a single continuous closed topological path.
